reviewed_records.label: Move Down
reviewed_records.depicts: Shopping basket with a downward arrow at the lower right
reviewed_records.purpose: Show downward movement, downward navigation, or moving an item to a lower position.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface moves downward in order, hierarchy, or directional navigation.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for download or decline when the meaning is not actual downward movement.

reviewed_records.label: Move Up
reviewed_records.depicts: Shopping basket with an upward arrow at the lower right
reviewed_records.purpose: Show upward movement, upward navigation, or moving an item to a higher position.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface moves upward in order, hierarchy, or directional navigation.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for upload or positive trend when the meaning is not actual upward movement.

reviewed_records.label: Back
reviewed_records.depicts: Dotted field with a solid vertical line on the left
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a back action or a move to the previous screen, panel, or step.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface moves backward to the previous screen, panel, or navigation level.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for undo or dismiss when the action is not actual back navigation.

reviewed_records.label: Forward
